_doc: Trading hours per asset class and per symbol group (a group wins over the class). Each session is a time zone and windows; a window opens on each listed day at start (local time) and closes at end, on the next day when end <= start. 'tradable' is when the instrument can be traded. Holidays and early closes are not modelled. Override per symbol in the workspace's _asset_meta.json under 'trading_hours'.
